Coram : P. SATHASIVAM*, RANJAN GOGOI, SHIVA KIRTI SINGH
Constitution of India, 1950: A B c Art. 21 rlw Art. 721161- Delay in execution of death sentence - Delay of 11 years in decision of mercy petition under Art. 72 - Held: Exorbitant delay in disposal of mercy petition renders the process of execution of death sentence and, therefore, 0 inexecutable -- Furthermore, such imprisonment, occasioned by inordinate delay in disposal of mercy petitions, is beyond the sentence accorded by the court and to that extent is extra­ legal and excessive -- The unreasonable delay caused qualifies as the supervening
